import itertools
n=11
nums=range(n)
# backtrack
solution=None
used=set()
used_diff=set()
seq=[0]
used.add(0)

def backtrack():
    global solution
    if len(seq)==n:
        solution=seq.copy()
        return True
    for x in nums:
        if x in used: continue
        d=abs(x-seq[-1])
        if d==0 or d>n-1 or d in used_diff: continue
        used.add(x); used_diff.add(d); seq.append(x)
        if backtrack(): return True
        seq.pop(); used.remove(x); used_diff.remove(d)
    return False
